## Overview

This document presents tables on patient demographics used for ML modeling. It primarily reports on GENIE data.

## Loading data

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

source("../R/utils.R")
```

# Aggregation of data by cancer type

Data split by OncoTree codes

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
cTypeLvl1Cnts <- perPatientLevel1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(isOncoKbLevel1 == 1) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_Level1_patients=n()) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_Level1_patients))
lvl1Thresh <- 250
cTypeThresh <- cTypeLvl1Cnts[cTypeLvl1Cnts$n_Level1_patients >= lvl1Thresh,]

cTypeRep <- perPatientLevel1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::row_number()==1)

cTypeCnts <- perPatientLevel1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_patients=n(),
                   ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_patients))


cTypeCntTbl <- cTypeThresh %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cTypeRep[,c("ONCOTREE_CODE","CANCER_TYPE","CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED")],by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cTypeCnts,by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percActionable = 100*n_Level1_patients/n_patients,
                actionableEvents = paste0(n_Level1_patients, " (", round(percActionable, 1), "%)"))

#cTypeCntTblPerc <- two_group_count_percentage(cTypeCntTbl,"n_patients","n_Level1_patients")


outCntTbl <- cTypeCntTbl[,c("ONCOTREE_CODE",
               "CANCER_TYPE",
               "CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED",
               "n_patients",
               "actionableEvents")]
colnames(outCntTbl) <- c("OT code",
               "cancer type",
               "cancer type detailed",
               "number of patients",
               "actionable events")
knitr::kable(outCntTbl, )
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(outCntTbl, )
```

# Aggregation by sex and age

Data split by sex codes

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
sexCnts <- perPatientLevel1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_patients_total = n(),
                   n_male=sum(SEX=="Male"),
                   percMale = 100*n_male/n_patients_total,
                   maleCntStr = paste0(n_male, " (", round(percMale, 1), "%)"),
                   n_female=sum(SEX=="Female"),
                   percFemale = 100*n_female/n_patients_total,
                   femaleCntStr = paste0(n_female, " (", round(percFemale, 1), "%)"),
                   n_unknown=sum(!(SEX=="Male" | SEX=="Female")),
                   percUnknown = 100*n_unknown/n_patients_total,
                   unknownCntStr = paste0(n_unknown, " (", round(percUnknown, 1), "%)"),
                   mean_age=mean(AGE_AT_SEQ_REPORT))


cTypeCntTbl <- cTypeThresh %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cTypeRep[,c("ONCOTREE_CODE","CANCER_TYPE","CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED")],by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cTypeCnts,by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sexCnts,by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percActionable = 100*n_Level1_patients/n_patients,
                actionableEvents = paste0(n_Level1_patients, " (", round(percActionable, 1), "%)"))

outSexTbl <- cTypeCntTbl[,c("CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED",
                            "maleCntStr",
                            "femaleCntStr",
                            "unknownCntStr")]
colnames(outSexTbl) <- c("cancer type detailed",
                         "male",
                         "female",
                         "uknown sex")


```

```{r}
knitr::kable(outSexTbl, )
```

# Most common mutated genes for each cancer type

top five actionable genes for each cancer type

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

geneCnts <- perPatientLevel1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(isOncoKbLevel1==1) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE,Hugo_Symbol) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_gene_mutated = n()) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(ONCOTREE_CODE,desc(n_gene_mutated)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::row_number() < 6)

cTypeCntTbl <- cTypeThresh %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cTypeRep[,c("ONCOTREE_CODE","CANCER_TYPE","CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED")],by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cTypeCnts,by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(geneCnts,by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percActionable = 100*n_gene_mutated/n_Level1_patients,
                geneOfactionableEvents = paste0(n_gene_mutated, " (", round(percActionable, 1), "%)"))

outGeneTbl <- cTypeCntTbl[,c("CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED",
                            "Hugo_Symbol",
                            "geneOfactionableEvents")]
colnames(outGeneTbl) <- c("cancer type detailed",
                         "gene",
                         "count and perc of actionable events")
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(outGeneTbl, )
```

# Most coding mutations for each cancer type

Ten most common mutations for each cancer type

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

mutCnts <- perPatientLevel1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(isOncoKbLevel1==1) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE,Hugo_Symbol,HGVSp_Short) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_mutated = n()) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(ONCOTREE_CODE,desc(n_mutated)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::row_number() < 11)

cTypeCntTbl <- cTypeThresh %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cTypeRep[,c("ONCOTREE_CODE","CANCER_TYPE","CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED")],by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cTypeCnts,by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mutCnts,by=c("ONCOTREE_CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percActionable = 100*n_mutated/n_Level1_patients,
                mutOfactionableEvents = paste0(n_mutated, " (", round(percActionable, 1), "%)"))

outMutTbl <- cTypeCntTbl[,c("CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED",
                            "Hugo_Symbol",
                            "HGVSp_Short",
                            "mutOfactionableEvents")]
colnames(outMutTbl) <- c("cancer type detailed",
                         "gene",
                         "protein mutation",
                         "count and perc of actionable events")
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(outMutTbl, )

```

# Age distributions actionable vs non-actionable

```{r}
print("subjects without an age value:")
print(table(is.na(perPatientLevel1$AGE_AT_SEQ_REPORT)))

iMatchCtype <- perPatientLevel1$ONCOTREE_CODE %in% cTypeThresh$ONCOTREE_CODE
lvlEvents <- perPatientLevel1[iMatchCtype & !is.na(perPatientLevel1$AGE_AT_SEQ_REPORT),]
lvlEvents$actionabilityStr <- "no Level 1 event"
lvlEvents[lvlEvents$isOncoKbLevel1==1,"actionabilityStr"] <- "Level 1 event"
lvlEvents$actionabilityStr2 <- "Level1Event"
lvlEvents[lvlEvents$isOncoKbLevel1==1,"actionabilityStr2"] <- "NoLevel1Event"


lvlCenter <- lvlEvents %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE,actionabilityStr2) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(median_age=median(AGE_AT_SEQ_REPORT))
  #dplyr::summarise(mean_age=mean(AGE_AT_SEQ_REPORT)) 

lvlCenterLong <- lvlCenter %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = actionabilityStr2,values_from=median_age) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ageDiff=abs(Level1Event-NoLevel1Event),
                diffString=paste0("median difference = ",round(ageDiff,1)),
                x=105,
                y=0.02) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(ageDiff))

lvlEvents$ONCOTREE_CODE <- factor(lvlEvents$ONCOTREE_CODE,levels=lvlCenterLong$ONCOTREE_CODE)
lvlCenterLong$ONCOTREE_CODE <- factor(lvlCenterLong$ONCOTREE_CODE,levels=lvlCenterLong$ONCOTREE_CODE)

outF <-  paste0(outDir,"/age_difference_distribution_by_actionability.pdf")
ggplot(lvlEvents, aes(x = AGE_AT_SEQ_REPORT, color=actionabilityStr)) +
  geom_density(alpha=.4)+
  geom_vline(data = lvlCenterLong, aes(xintercept = Level1Event), color = "blue", linetype = "solid") +
  geom_vline(data = lvlCenterLong, aes(xintercept = NoLevel1Event), color = "red", linetype = "solid") +
  geom_text(data = lvlCenterLong, aes(x = x, y = y, label = diffString), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, size = 4) +
  facet_grid(ONCOTREE_CODE~.,scale="free") +
    theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
ggsave(outF,height = 15, width = 9)  

```

# Sex differences among actionable vs non-actionable 

```{r}
{r}
print("subjects without an age value:")
print(table(is.na(perPatientLevel1$SEX)))

print(table(perPatientLevel1$SEX))

iMatchCtype <- perPatientLevel1$ONCOTREE_CODE %in% cTypeThresh$ONCOTREE_CODE
iUnknown <- perPatientLevel1$SEX == "Unknown" | perPatientLevel1$SEX == "Other"
lvlEvents <- perPatientLevel1[iMatchCtype & !iUnknown,]
lvlEvents$actionabilityStr <- "no Level 1 event"
lvlEvents[lvlEvents$isOncoKbLevel1==1,"actionabilityStr"] <- "Level 1 event"
lvlEvents$actionabilityStr2 <- "Level1Event"
lvlEvents[lvlEvents$isOncoKbLevel1==1,"actionabilityStr2"] <- "NoLevel1Event"


# lvlCenter <- lvlEvents %>%
#   dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE,actionabilityStr2) %>%
#   dplyr::summarise(male=sum(SEX=="Male"),
#                    female=sum(SEX=="Female"))

lvlCenter <- lvlEvents %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE,actionabilityStr2,SEX) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n=n())


outF <-  paste0(outDir,"/sex_difference_distribution_by_actionability.pdf")
ggplot(lvlCenter,aes(x=actionabilityStr2,y=n,fill=SEX))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(ONCOTREE_CODE~.,scale="free") 
ggsave(outF,height = 15, width = 9)  

lvlProportion <- lvlCenter %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ONCOTREE_CODE,actionabilityStr2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion=n/sum(n))

outF <-  paste0(outDir,"/sex_difference_proportion_by_actionability.pdf")
ggplot(lvlProportion,aes(x=actionabilityStr2,y=proportion,fill=SEX))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(ONCOTREE_CODE~.,scale="free") 
ggsave(outF,height = 15, width = 6)  


```
